title: Starklens
tagline: StarkLens: Intelligent Swap widget on Starknet 🌐, leveraging intent-based matching, and offline-capabilities for extensive swap coverage

prizes.placement: Pool for projects which use Dynamic
prizes.title: Pool for projects which use Dynamic

description:
Meme Tokens is becoming one of the easiest trends for scaling user adoptions on many blockchains. But how much control do users have on their tokens?

StarkLens is designed for seamless, Oracle-less swaps on the Starknet blockchain. Our project leverages AI to interpret user intents and match them with the best possible swaps, while also enabling off-site interactions via SMS.

By removing the reliance on oracles, we offer users direct control to own and gatekeep their swaps, ensuring a transparent and user-centric trading experience. 

Improving UX with our AI accessibilities, users can access the query swap market offline via SMS
how_its_made:
AI Query Classification:
	•	Starklens AI classifies queries into 3 categories; transaction, price, or general inquiries. and routes the prompt to the LLM chain with appropriate logic to respond accurately.

Transaction Chain and Semantic Queries:
	•	The transaction chain performs semantic similarity queries on events saved in our Postgress-db. This db is periodically populated by the VOYAGE API, which tracks and logs intents and states changes from our smart contract.

Dynamic:
We used Dynamic to create unique user identities, ensuring that a user's transaction is properly indexed on our ProgressDB.

Starknet Smart Contract:
	•	Our Swap contract is written in Cairo and deployed on the Devnet. Users can token gate their swap by creating access conditions such as "fixed counterparty Account gating", "NFT gating", and "Minimum Balance gating"

 Off-site Interaction:
	•	Users can interact with StarkLens AI endpoint `api/sms/`  via SMS (configured on Twilio), get market insights, and get information about current intents without initially requiring internet connectivity.
